stories.title: Guerre en Ukraine : une "attaque systémique" est "en cours" contre les transports ferroviaires ukrainiens, une alerte "de haut niveau" déclenchée

en.title: War in Ukraine: a "systemic attack" is "underway" against Ukrainian rail transport, a "high-level" alert triggered
en.summary: Ukraine's railway company has issued a high-level alert regarding systematic attacks on the country's rail infrastructure, following a strike on a train to Poland carrying 206 passengers.

stories.title: Marine Le Pen détaille une série de propositions sur le logement, qui sera "un des grands chantiers" de son quinquennat si elle est élue

en.title: Marine Le Pen details a series of proposals on housing, which will be "one of the major projects" of her five-year term if elected
en.summary: The National Rally candidate presented housing reform proposals focused on homeownership and national priority as a key platform if she wins the presidential election.

stories.title: Un train à destination de Varsovie frappé par un drone russe en Ukraine, une «attaque systémique en cours» contre le rail à travers le pays

en.title: A train bound for Warsaw struck by a Russian drone in Ukraine, a "systemic attack underway" against rail across the country
en.summary: A Russian drone attacked a train heading to Warsaw near the Poland-Ukraine border, prompting Ukraine's railway company to declare a systematic attack campaign underway. All 206 passengers aboard were unharmed.

stories.title: Présidentielle 2027 : à la Fête de l’Humanité, Jean-Luc Mélenchon vole la vedette aux communistes

en.title: 2027 Presidential election: at the Humanity Festival, Jean-Luc Mélenchon steals the show from communists
en.summary: Jean-Luc Mélenchon, the leftist candidate, made multiple appearances at the radical left gathering, overshadowing communist candidate Fabien Roussel's campaign launch.

stories.title: Fête de l’Humanité : pour Jean-Luc Mélenchon, l’occasion manquée de l’appel au rassemblement

en.title: Fête de l'Humanité: for Jean-Luc Mélenchon, a missed opportunity for a call to unite
en.summary: Jean-Luc Mélenchon, representing La France Insoumise in the presidential race, delivered an economics-focused speech on public debt at the Fête de l'Humanité. The address did not resolve doubts among some left-wing voters about his credibility as a candidate against Marine Le Pen in a potential second round.

stories.title: "Notre ambition est d'aller vers une société de propriétaires" : Marine Le Pen, candidate à la présidentielle 2027, développe ses idées sur le logement

en.title: "Our ambition is to move towards a society of property owners": Marine Le Pen, candidate for the 2027 presidential election, develops her ideas on housing
en.summary: Marine Le Pen, the Rassemblement national candidate leading in polls, outlined her housing policy in her first major speech of a campaign marked by controversies and tensions with deputy Jordan Bardella.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, présidentielle 2027 : Marine Le Pen, lors de son discours de rentrée politique à Hénin-Beaumont, promet que le logement sera « un des grands chantiers du quinquennat »

en.title: LIVE, 2027 presidential election: Marine Le Pen, during her political comeback speech in Hénin-Beaumont, promises that housing will be "one of the major projects of the five-year term"
en.summary: Marine Le Pen, the RN candidate for the 2027 presidential election, pledged to prioritize housing as a major initiative in her first significant campaign speech delivered amid ongoing controversies and friction with her running mate.

stories.title: En Ukraine, les chemins de fer visés par une "attaque systémique"

en.title: In Ukraine, railways targeted by a "systematic attack"
en.summary: Ukraine's railway company warned of a systematic attack underway against rail infrastructure across the country. President Zelensky stated that a Russian drone deliberately struck a train near the Polish border without causing casualties.

stories.title: Naufrage d'un ferry en Indonésie : au moins 6 morts et 130 disparus

en.title: Ferry sinks in Indonesia: at least 6 dead and 130 missing
en.summary: A ferry connecting Indonesian islands Java and Bornëo capsized due to bad weather, killing six people and leaving 130 missing, while 107 others were rescued.

stories.title: Guerre en Ukraine : une «attaque systémique» est «en cours» contre le rail à travers le pays

en.title: War in Ukraine: a "systematic" attack is "underway" against railways across the country
en.summary: President Zelensky reported that a Russian drone struck a train near the Polish border as part of broader attacks on Ukraine's rail infrastructure.

stories.title: Mondial de basket : les Bleues rêvent de renverser l’hégémonique Team USA en finale

en.title: Basketball World Cup: the French team dreams of overcoming dominant Team USA in the final
en.summary: France's undefeated women's basketball team, led by Gabby Williams, faces the United States in the World Cup final on September 13 in Berlin, two years after losing by one point in the Olympic final.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : une « attaque systémique » est « en cours » contre le rail à travers le pays, selon la compagnie des chemins de fer ukrainiens

en.title: LIVE, war in Ukraine: a "systematic" attack is "underway" against railways across the country, according to the Ukrainian railway company
en.summary: A locomotive of a passenger train from Kyiv to Warsaw was hit by a Russian drone 2 kilometers from the Polish border, causing no casualties.

stories.title: Face au retour de l’inflation, la Fed prête à ressortir l’arme des taux

en.title: Facing inflation's return, the Fed ready to deploy rate weapon
en.summary: The U.S. Federal Reserve may raise interest rates as soon as Wednesday to combat rising inflation. The decision carries major implications for credit, investment, and markets, testing new Fed chair Kevin Warsh's independence from Donald Trump.

stories.title: Sous la menace des drones de Moscou, la Moldavie en première ligne face à l'escalade de la Russie

en.title: Threatened by Moscow drones, Moldova on the front line facing Russian escalation
en.summary: A Russian drone incursion this week delayed Volodymyr Zelensky's departure from Chisinau, highlighting Moldova's vulnerability. The small republic, positioned between Ukraine and Romania, faces intensifying pressure from Moscow.

stories.title: Quand la souveraineté spatiale devient une urgence stratégique

en.title: When space sovereignty becomes a strategic imperative
en.summary: The signing of the 15.7 billion dollar Iris² contract demonstrates European intentions for sovereignty in space telecommunications. However, significant challenges remain in achieving this objective.

stories.title: Rugby : Avec Stade toulousain – Bordeaux-Bègles, le Top 14 sort le champagne

en.title: Rugby: With Toulouse - Bordeaux-Bègles, Top 14 brings out the champagne
en.summary: Toulouse, the four-time defending French champion, hosts Bordeaux-Bègles, a two-time European champion, on Sunday, September 13. The Top 14 showcases top-level rugby competition in its second round.
